_meta.title: Farthest Planet from Rocket
_meta.subject: Space Science / Distance
_meta.description: A rocket launches from a fixed position. The student identifies which planet in the solar system is the farthest away — a conceptual grasp of scale in space.

question.text: The rocket needs to travel to the most distant planet. Which one is farthest away from the rocket?
question.hint: Think about which planet in the solar system is the most distant.

primary.questionOverride: Which planet is the farthest from the rocket?
primary.hint: The farthest planet is also the coldest and darkest!

middle.hint: Which planet takes the longest to orbit the Sun?

high_school.questionOverride: Using the rocket's normalised canvas position as a proxy for the Sun's position, select the planet with the maximum Euclidean distance.

university.questionOverride: Rank the four planets by their semi-major axis in AU and identify the argmax. Corroborate with the canvas distance metric as a sanity check.
